arguments.text: 6000 m, 5 legs (4 x 1250 + 1000), turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) instruments: compare pod shaft power, boat-model power, GPS speed and HR; pod drift = shaft reading moves while GPS speed and HR do not -> set_belief pod_gain; weed/drag = GPS speed drops at same shaft power and HR -> clear_rudder. (2) radio/course changes -> set_race_distance + tell. (3) CP check: HR climbing at steady shaft power below cp_shaft means CP set high; HR flat above cp_shaft means CP set low. (4) FINISH: pacer only pushes if pod reserve > 40 pct under 800 m; at ~1100 m left, if reserve left is 5-40 pct (or CP looks low), call a +effort piece sized with test_cost to spend it by the line. Watches: eff_ratio_change (boat-model/shaft share moving), wake at 1100 m left.
